rationale: Samuel and Avinash both work in deep learning but bring complementary strengths—Samuel as a co-founder building DeepShare Inc. with Python and MXNet expertise, and Avinash as a Senior Engineer at Ltts with broader ML engineering experience spanning reinforcement learning, NLP, and native mobile development. Their combined deep-learning foundation plus Avinash's additional iOS and full-stack capabilities could create interesting synergies for technical collaboration or product development.
intro_message: Samuel Wei, meet Avinash Reddy — you're both deep-learning engineers with complementary skill sets, and Avinash's experience across reinforcement learning, NLP, and mobile development could add valuable dimensions to your work at DeepShare.
